subject: Moneta Bank SIG: follow-up on development governance artifacts
messages:
From: Emma Liu <emma.liu@monetabank.com>
To: irene.choi@redwood.ai
Cc: security@monetabank.com
Date: Sun, 2 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SIG follow-up: development governance artifacts we still need

Hi Irene,

Thanks again for the quick demo last week. Our security assessment team is finishing the Moneta SIG intake and has three clarifying asks related to your development governance responses:

1) A concise mapping that shows where code review evidence (pull request approvals, reviewer identities, and merge gates) is retained for a 12-month retention window.
2) A copy of the CI pipeline policy that documents required steps (linting, unit tests, SCA, secret-scan) and the automatic rollback conditions.
3) A matrix showing which roles have KMS/decryption privileges vs. who can approve change requests.

Would you be able to provide those artifacts by EOD Tuesday (Aug 4)? If you need to redact anything, please call out the redactions.

Best,
Emma
Senior Information Security Analyst
Moneta Bank

---
Attachment: request-summary.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)

From: irene.choi@redwood.ai
To: Emma Liu <emma.liu@monetabank.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, jonas.weber@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 2 Aug 2026 11:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG follow-up: development governance artifacts we still need

Emma —

Thanks for the clear asks. We're on it. Quick notes on scope:
- Code review artifacts: we can export PR audit logs from the last 18 months. We typically retain approvals and reviewer IDs in our internal audit index; we will produce a CSV mapping PR ID -> approvers -> timestamps with minimal metadata.
- CI policy: we'll share the human-readable pipeline policy (pdf) and link to the canonical YAML for reviewers.
- KMS matrix: we can provide a role-based access table and annotate who has decrypt vs. admin keys; we will redact user IDs for privacy where required.

I'll triage with Marissa and Jonas and deliver a bundled zip to the shared Drive link by Tue EOD Pacific. If Moneta needs signed attestations, let us know and we will escalate.

—Irene
Director, Trust & Security
Redwood Inference

---
Attachment: none

From: marissa.cole@redwood.ai
To: irene.choi@redwood.ai, jonas.weber@redwood.ai
Cc: lauren.bishop@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 09:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG follow-up: development governance artifacts we still need

Team —

Plan to compile three artifacts:
1) dev-governance-index.csv (PR retention mapping + sample redacted PR lines)
2) ci-pipeline-controls.pdf (policy narrative + list of automatic gates) and pipeline-yaml-link.txt (link to canonical CI config)
3) kms-access-matrix.xlsx (roles, group mappings, approval flow for key operations)

Jonas will pull the PR audit export; I'll curate the policy doc and add the rollback trigger definitions. Lauren — can you run a redaction pass on the PR export for any PII and create a short readme that explains redaction rules?

Target: assemble and upload bundle to the shared Drive by Tue 15:00 PT. I'll also attach a short cover note for Moneta explaining redactions and evidence validity.

Thanks,
Marissa
Senior Compliance Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachment: none

From: lauren.bishop@redwood.ai
To: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, irene.choi@redwood.ai, jonas.weber@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 11:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG follow-up: development governance artifacts we still need

Marissa —

I've completed the redaction pass on the PR export. Notes:
- Removed complete email addresses and replaced with internal IDs (usr_####).
- Kept reviewer role metadata (team, reviewer_role) intact to demonstrate segregation of duties.
- Flagged 3 PRs that contain customer-specific snippets; added explanatory footnotes for each.

I also created dev-governance-index.csv and a short README (README-redaction.txt). Uploading to the draft folder now.

Lauren
Legal & Privacy Counsel (interim)
Redwood Inference

---
Attachment: dev-governance-index.csv (csv stub), README-redaction.txt (text stub)

From: jonas.weber@redwood.ai
To: Emma Liu <emma.liu@monetabank.com>, irene.choi@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai, lauren.bishop@redwood.ai
Cc: security@monetabank.com
Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 15:38:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG follow-up: development governance artifacts we still need

Emma —

Bundle uploaded to shared Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB_example_shared_folder

Contents (high level):
- dev-governance-index.csv — export of PR metadata (18 months), reviewer IDs redacted to usr_####, columns: pr_id, repo, created_at, merged_at, approvals_count, approver_roles.
- ci-pipeline-controls.pdf — narrative of pipeline stages (lint, unit, integ, ssca, secret-scan), sample YAML link included. Auto-rollback triggers: failing security scan; failing >2 consecutive integration test runs after a hotfix.
- kms-access-matrix.xlsx — roles -> key operations mapping; includes process for emergency key-use approvals (two-person auth + manager sign-off).
- README-redaction.txt — details on what was redacted and why, retention policy excerpt (we retain PR audit logs for 18 months, event stream for 36 months).

If Moneta's team wants a short call to walk the artifacts, we're available tomorrow morning PT. Otherwise please confirm receipt and whether anything needs further context or signed attestation.

Thanks,
Jonas
Senior Product Security Engineer
Redwood Inference

---
Attachments: dev-governance-index.csv, ci-pipeline-controls.pdf, kms-access-matrix.xlsx
